q: Bowen's sofic entropy for Bernoulli shifts Γ⟳(X₀,μ₀)^Γ of a sofic group equals:
opts: The sofic entropy of the sofic approximation
exp: Bowen (2010): h_Σ(Γ⟳(X₀,μ₀)^Γ) = H(μ₀) for any sofic approximation Σ. This generalises Kolmogorov–Sinai to non-amenable settings. Two Bernoulli shifts of a free group are isomorphic iff H(μ₀)=H(ν₀) — entropy is still the complete invariant.
